reference: T003 native project compile in WeChat DevTools and Simulator observation of the converged FE-001 candidate (existing 小树荫助手 project, AppID wx746a39363f67ae95); openapi-fetch probe bridge and dependency removed
environment: macOS 26.6.2 arm64; WeChat DevTools app build 36.6.0 cask 2.02.2609250, CLI server 127.0.0.1:32562, CLI login true; Simulator iPhone 12/13 (Pro), iOS 10.0.1, base library 3.18.1, WeChat 8.0.5; AppID wx746a39363f67ae95; TypeScript compiler plugin; locked toolchain Node 26.13.0, Bun 1.4.4, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vitest 3.2.7, miniprogram-api-typings 5.3.1; candidate branch feat/001-wechat-runtime-transport

operations.expected: DevTools CLI reports an authenticated session
operations.actual: {"login":true} with IDE server listening on http://127.0.0.1:32562

operations.expected: The imported existing project opens in the IDE
operations.actual: exit 0, "✔ open"; AppID resolved to wx746a39363f67ae95

operations.expected: Native TypeScript compile and preview package of the converged candidate succeed
operations.actual: exit 0, "✔ Using AppID: wx746a39363f67ae95", "✔ preview", preview package TOTAL 12.5 KB (12825 bytes); terminal QR printed

operations.expected: Optional: write QR image/info to an explicit path
operations.actual: FAIL on this DevTools build: code 10 "二维码输出路径无效或不存在" (image and terminal formats); non-blocking because the default terminal QR path produces the preview package; recorded as non-blocking defect

operations.expected: Automation channel opens the compiled candidate in the Simulator
operations.actual: {"autoPort":9420,"requestedAutoPort":9420}; SYSTEM devtools / iPhone 12/13 (Pro) / iOS 10.0.1 / SDK 3.18.1 / WeChat 8.0.5

operations.expected: Bootstrap page and isolated runtime probe page render on the Simulator without a compile-error overlay
operations.actual: BOOTSTRAP {"entry":"FE-001 bootstrap","sdkVersion":"SDK 3.18.1"}; PROBE lines "SDK 3.18.1 / devtools / iPhone 12/13 (Pro)" and "version 8.0.5"; pageStack ["probes/runtime/index"]; screenshots simulator-bootstrap.png and simulator-probe.png captured

defects.description: WeChat DevTools build 36.6.0 rejects "cli preview --qr-output <path>" (image and terminal formats) with error code 10 "二维码输出路径无效或不存在", so QR/info files cannot be scripted on this build; the default terminal QR and preview package are produced normally and compile/Simulator verification is unaffected.
